description: Record a TOP to a movie file (.mov/.mp4) via a Movie File Out TOP — for exporting a clip or a loop, where render_output only saves a single frame. start begins recording (pass file, fps); pass `seconds` to auto-stop after a fixed length, or call stop to finish (stop also cleans up the recorder node). The file is written by TouchDesigner on the TD machine. For individual numbered frames, use render_output per frame.

action.description: start recording the TOP to a file, or stop the current recording.

file.description: (start) Output movie path on the TD machine, with a .mov or .mp4 extension. Absolute path recommended.

node_path.description: Path of the TOP to record.

seconds.description: (start) If set, auto-stop after this many seconds (records a fixed-length loop); otherwise record until you call stop.

name: record_movie
title: Record movie / sequence
